en: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me. Hasan ibn Ayan narrated to us. Maqil narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Abla, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz. He said: Rabi ibn Sabrah al-Juhani narrated to us, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade temporary marriage and said: Indeed, it is forbidden from this day of yours until the Day of Resurrection. Whoever gave anything should not take it back.
de: Salamah ibn Shabib überlieferte mir. Hasan ibn Ayan überlieferte uns. Maqil überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abi Abla, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz. Er sagte: Rabi ibn Sabrah al-Juhani überlieferte uns, from his father, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) forbade Zeitehe and said: Indeed, it is forbidden from this day of yours until the Day of Resurrection. Whoever gave anything should not take it back. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Abd Allah and al-Hasan, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali, from their father, from Ali ibn Abi Talib. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade temporary marriage with women on the day of Khaybar and the eating of the meat of domestic donkeys.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Abd Allah and al-Hasan, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali, from their father, from Ali ibn Abi Talib. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade Zeitehe with women on the day of Khaybar and the eating of the meat of Hausesel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Asma al-Dubai narrated it to us. Juwayriyah narrated to us, from Malik, with this chain. He said: He heard Ali ibn Abi Talib say to a certain man: You are a confused man. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade us. It is like the hadith of Yahya ibn Yahya from Malik.
de: Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Asma al-Dubai narrated it to us. Juwayriyah überlieferte uns, from Malik, with this chain. Er sagte: He heard Ali ibn Abi Talib say to a certain man: You are a confused man. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade us. It is like the hadith of Yahya ibn Yahya from Malik. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Numayr, and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from al-Hasan and Abd Allah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali, from their father, from Ali. The Prophet (peace be upon him) forbade temporary marriage on the day of Khaybar and the meat of domestic donkeys.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Numayr, and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from al-Hasan and Abd Allah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali, from their father, from Ali. The Prophet (peace be upon him) forbade Zeitehe on the day of Khaybar and the meat of Hausesel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Hasan and Abd Allah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali, from their father, from Ali. He heard Ibn Abbas make temporary marriage with women seem permissible, so he said: Take it slowly, Ibn Abbas. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade it on the day of Khaybar and forbade the meat of domestic donkeys.
de: Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Hasan and Abd Allah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali, from their father, from Ali. He heard Ibn Abbas make Zeitehe with women seem permissible, so he said: Take it slowly, Ibn Abbas. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade it on the day of Khaybar and forbade the meat of Hausesel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. They both said: Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Hasan and Abd Allah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, from their father. He heard Ali ibn Abi Talib say to Ibn Abbas: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade temporary marriage with women on the day of Khaybar and the eating of the meat of domestic donkeys.
de: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. They both said: Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, from al-Hasan and Abd Allah, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, from their father. He heard Ali ibn Abi Talib say to Ibn Abbas: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade Zeitehe with women on the day of Khaybar and the eating of the meat of Hausesel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik ibn Anas, from Ibn Shihab, from Abd Allah and al-Hasan, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali, from their father, from Ali ibn Abi Talib. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade temporary marriage with women on the day of Khaybar and the meat of domestic donkeys.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik ibn Anas, from Ibn Shihab, from Abd Allah and al-Hasan, the two sons of Muhammad ibn Ali, from their father, from Ali ibn Abi Talib. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade Zeitehe with women on the day of Khaybar and the meat of Hausesel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Numayr, and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. They said: Sufyan narrated to us. Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us. Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah narrated to me. They both said: Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me. Ishaq and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us. They both said: Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar informed us. All of them narrated from al-Zuhri with this chain. In the narration of Yunus it also says: and the eating of the meat of domestic donkeys.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Numayr, and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. They said: Sufyan überlieferte uns. Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns. Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah überlieferte mir. They both said: Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir. Ishaq and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns. They both said: Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns. All of them narrated from al-Zuhri with this chain. In the narration of Yunus it also says: and the eating of the meat of Hausesel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah al-Qanabi narrated to us. Malik narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A woman must not be married together with her paternal aunt, nor a woman together with her maternal aunt.
de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah al-Qanabi überlieferte uns. Malik überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A woman must not be married together with her Tante väterlicherseits, nor a woman together with her Tante mütterlicherseits. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Rumh ibn al-Muhajir narrated to us. Al-Layth informed us, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Irak ibn Malik, from Abu Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade four women from being combined in marriage: a woman together with her paternal aunt, and a woman together with her maternal aunt.
de: Muhammad ibn Rumh ibn al-Muhajir überlieferte uns. Al-Layth berichtete uns, from Yazid ibn Abi Habib, from Irak ibn Malik, from Abu Hurayra, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) forbade four women from being combined in Ehe: a woman together with her Tante väterlicherseits, and a woman together with her Tante mütterlicherseits. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qanab narrated to us. Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd al-Aziz narrated to us. Ibn Maslamah said: He was a Medinan from the Ansar, descended from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf. He narrated from Ibn Shihab, from Qabisah ibn Dhuayb, from Abu Hurayra. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: A paternal aunt must not be married together with her brother's daughter, nor a brother's daughter together with her maternal aunt.
de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qanab überlieferte uns. Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd al-Aziz überlieferte uns. Ibn Maslamah said: He was a Medinan from the Ansar, descended from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf. He narrated from Ibn Shihab, from Qabisah ibn Dhuayb, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: A Tante väterlicherseits must not be married together with her brother's daughter, nor a brother's daughter together with her Tante mütterlicherseits. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab. Qabisah ibn Dhuayb al-Kabi informed me that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man from combining a woman with her paternal aunt, or a woman with her maternal aunt. Ibn Shihab said: We consider the paternal aunt of her father and the maternal aunt of her father to have the same status.
de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab. Qabisah ibn Dhuayb al-Kabi berichtete mir that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man from combining a woman with her Tante väterlicherseits, or a woman with her Tante mütterlicherseits. Ibn Shihab said: We consider the Tante väterlicherseits of her father and the Tante mütterlicherseits of her father to have the same status. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Main al-Raqashi narrated to me. Khalid ibn al-Harith narrated to us. Hisham narrated to us, from Yahya, that he wrote to him from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A woman must not be married together with her paternal aunt, nor together with her maternal aunt.
de: Abu Main al-Raqashi überlieferte mir. Khalid ibn al-Harith überlieferte uns. Hisham überlieferte uns, from Yahya, that he wrote to him from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A woman must not be married together with her Tante väterlicherseits, nor together with her Tante mütterlicherseits. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa narrated to us, from Shayban, from Yahya. Abu Salamah narrated to me that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same.
de: Ishaq ibn Mansur überlieferte mir. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa überlieferte uns, from Shayban, from Yahya. Abu Salamah überlieferte mir that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said the same. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: A man must not propose over his brother's proposal, bid over his brother's bid, or marry a woman together with her paternal aunt or maternal aunt. A woman must not ask for her sister's divorce so that she may take her place and empty her dish. Let her marry, for she will have only what Allah has allotted to her.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: A man must not propose over his brother's Heiratsantrag, bid over his brother's bid, or marry a woman together with her Tante väterlicherseits or Tante mütterlicherseits. A woman must not ask for her sister's divorce so that she may take her place and empty her dish. Let her marry, for she will have only what Allah has allotted to her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhriz ibn Awn ibn Abi Awn narrated to me. Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from Dawud ibn Abi Hind, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a woman from being married together with her paternal aunt or maternal aunt, and forbade a woman from asking for her sister's divorce so that she could take what is in her dish. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, provides for her.
de: Muhriz ibn Awn ibn Abi Awn überlieferte mir. Ali ibn Mushir überlieferte uns, from Dawud ibn Abi Hind, from Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a woman from being married together with her Tante väterlicherseits or Tante mütterlicherseits, and forbade a woman from asking for her sister's divorce so that she could take what is in her dish. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, provides for her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, Ibn Bashshar, and Abu Bakr ibn Nafi narrated to us. The wording belongs to Ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Nafi. They said: Ibn Abi Adi informed us, from Shubah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade combining a woman with her paternal aunt and combining a woman with her maternal aunt.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna, Ibn Bashshar, and Abu Bakr ibn Nafi überlieferte uns. The wording belongs to Ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Nafi. They said: Ibn Abi Adi berichtete uns, from Shubah, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade combining a woman with her Tante väterlicherseits and combining a woman with her Tante mütterlicherseits. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Shababah narrated to us. Warqa narrated to us, from Amr ibn Dinar, with this chain and the same wording.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Shababah überlieferte uns. Warqa überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Dinar, with this chain and the same wording. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Nubayh ibn Wahb. Umar ibn Ubayd Allah wanted to marry Talhah ibn Umar to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr, so he sent for Aban ibn Uthman to attend, while Aban was the commander of the pilgrimage. Aban said: I heard Uthman ibn Affan say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A person in ihram must not marry, be married, or propose marriage.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Nubayh ibn Wahb. Umar ibn Ubayd Allah wanted to marry Talhah ibn Umar to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr, so he sent for Aban ibn Uthman to attend, while Aban was the commander of the pilgrimage. Aban said: I heard Uthman ibn Affan say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A Person im Ihram must not marry, be married, or propose Ehe. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Muqaddami narrated to us. Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Nafi. Nubayh ibn Wahb narrated to me. He said: Umar ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Mamr sent me while he was proposing to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Uthman for his son. He sent me to Aban ibn Uthman, who was at the pilgrimage site. He said: Am I to see him as a desert Arab? A person in ihram must not marry or be married. Uthman reported this to us from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him).
de: Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Muqaddami überlieferte uns. Hammad ibn Zayd überlieferte uns, from Ayyub, from Nafi. Nubayh ibn Wahb überlieferte mir. Er sagte: Umar ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Mamr sent me while he was proposing to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Uthman for his son. He sent me to Aban ibn Uthman, who was at the pilgrimage site. Er sagte: Am I to see him as a desert Arab? A Person im Ihram must not marry or be married. Uthman reported this to us from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Ghassan al-Mismai narrated to me. Abd al-Ala narrated to us. Abu al-Khattab Ziyad ibn Yahya narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Sawwa narrated to us. They both said: Sa'id narrated to us, from Matar and Yala ibn Hakim, from Nafi, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman ibn Affan. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A person in ihram must not marry, be married, or propose marriage.
de: Abu Ghassan al-Mismai überlieferte mir. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns. Abu al-Khattab Ziyad ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Sawwa überlieferte uns. They both said: Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Matar and Yala ibn Hakim, from Nafi, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman ibn Affan. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A Person im Ihram must not marry, be married, or propose Ehe. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Amr al-Naqid, and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ayyub ibn Musa, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman, attributing it to the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: A person in ihram must not marry or propose marriage.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Amr al-Naqid, and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Ayyub ibn Musa, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman, attributing it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: A Person im Ihram must not marry or propose Ehe. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuayb ibn al-Layth narrated to us. My father narrated to me, from my grandfather. Khalid ibn Yazid narrated to me. Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal narrated to me, from Nubayh ibn Wahb. Umar ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Mamr wanted to marry his son Talhah to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr during the pilgrimage, while Aban ibn Uthman was commander of the pilgrims. He sent to Aban: I want to marry Talhah ibn Umar, and would like you to attend. Aban said: Do I not see you as a coarse Iraqi? I heard Uthman ibn Affan say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A person in ihram must not marry.
de: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuayb ibn al-Layth überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte mir, from my grandfather. Khalid ibn Yazid überlieferte mir. Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal überlieferte mir, from Nubayh ibn Wahb. Umar ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Mamr wanted to marry his son Talhah to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr during the pilgrimage, while Aban ibn Uthman was commander of the pilgrims. He sent to Aban: I want to marry Talhah ibn Umar, and would like you to attend. Aban said: Do I not see you as a coarse Iraqi? I heard Uthman ibn Affan say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A Person im Ihram must not marry. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Numayr, and Ishaq al-Hanzali narrated to us, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Ibn Numayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abu al-Shatha. Ibn Abbas informed him that the Prophet (peace be upon him) married Maymunah while he was in ihram. Ibn Numayr added: I told this to al-Zuhri, who said: Yazid ibn al-Asamm informed me that he married her while he was free of ihram.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Numayr, and Ishaq al-Hanzali überlieferte uns, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Ibn Numayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abu al-Shatha. Ibn Abbas informed him that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) married Maymunah while he was in ihram. Ibn Numayr added: I told this to al-Zuhri, who said: Yazid ibn al-Asamm berichtete mir that he married her while he was free of ihram. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Dawud ibn Abd al-Rahman informed us, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd Abu al-Shatha, from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married Maymunah while he was in ihram.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Dawud ibn Abd al-Rahman berichtete uns, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd Abu al-Shatha, from Ibn Abbas. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married Maymunah while he was in ihram. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Yahya ibn Adam narrated to us. Jarir ibn Hazim narrated to us. Abu Fazarah narrated to us, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm. Maymunah bint al-Harith narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married her while he was free of ihram. He said: She was my maternal aunt and the maternal aunt of Ibn Abbas.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Adam überlieferte uns. Jarir ibn Hazim überlieferte uns. Abu Fazarah überlieferte uns, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm. Maymunah bint al-Harith überlieferte mir that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) married her while he was free of ihram. Er sagte: She was my Tante mütterlicherseits and the Tante mütterlicherseits of Ibn Abbas. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Layth narrated to us. Ibn Rumh narrated to us. Al-Layth informed us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: None of you should sell over the sale of another, and none of you should propose over another's proposal.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Layth überlieferte uns. Ibn Rumh überlieferte uns. Al-Layth berichtete uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: None of you should sell over the Verkauf of another, and none of you should propose over another's Heiratsantrag. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me, both from Yahya al-Qattan. Zuhayr said: Yahya narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, who informed me, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: A man must not sell over his brother's sale, nor propose over his brother's proposal, unless he gives him permission.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte mir, both from Yahya al-Qattan. Zuhayr said: Yahya überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, who berichtete mir, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: A man must not sell over his brother's Verkauf, nor propose over his brother's Heiratsantrag, unless he gives him permission. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, with this chain.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Ali ibn Mushir überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, with this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated it to me. Hammad narrated to us. Ayyub narrated to us, from Nafi, with this chain.
de: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated it to me. Hammad überlieferte uns. Ayyub überlieferte uns, from Nafi, with this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.
